heroSummary: Peoria Unified starts the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027. The calendar lists 180 student days, an October elementary conference and break window, Thanksgiving Break from November 22–26, a winter no-school window from December 17 through January 3, Spring Break from March 20–24, and a last day of school on Thursday, May 18, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Peoria Unified start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Peoria Unified starts the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Peoria Unified 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed Peoria Unified calendar lists 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the winter no-school window for Peoria Unified in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out for the winter no-school window from Friday, December 17, 2027, through Monday, January 3, 2028. Students return for the second term on Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Peoria Unified revisions.

customSections.label: What Peoria Unified Families Should Know
customSections.content: The 2027–28 Peoria Unified calendar uses an August opening date, a long winter break window, and a May ending. The PDF also marks elementary conference dates and teacher workdays that families should treat differently from regular attendance days.
